title: Stationery
slide_intent: Show how an identity persists across documents of different sizes and information densities. A reader should recognize the issuing institution on both a short card and a detailed agenda.
strategic_value: CSAIL can connect personal correspondence, event materials and mail through repeated marks and warm geometric accents.
demonstration: Letter sheets, business cards, an agenda, a flyer and an envelope form a stationery ensemble on a common gray field.
practical_value: Identify which specimen matches the communication before deciding how much room to allocate to the mark, contact information and message.

content_islands.name: Format inventory
content_islands.spec: Set Stationery and the list of formats in the narrow left column.

content_islands.name: Correspondence
content_islands.spec: Overlap the letter sheets in the upper-left field. Set the business cards above the agenda on the right.

content_islands.name: Additional formats
content_islands.spec: Place the event flyer and envelope beneath the correspondence, retaining their different proportions.
